_note: Labyrinth rooms of the Weltbauer (room key maze, its maze_zone; src/hell/hell_game.gd maze darkness, src/hell/hell_monsters.gd sight). Inside the maze zone the view turns dark: dark = how black the unseen is (0 to 1), sight_cells = how far the hero sees along open ground in cells (walls stop the view), soft_from = share of sight_cells from where the light fades out, rays = how finely the view is traced, fade = how fast the dark comes and goes (share per second), zoom = how much nearer the camera comes in the maze (1 = not at all). Monsters let out in a maze stand in that corridor (spawn_cells: how many cells along the corridor from the broken piece they may stand) and chase only while they see the hero within monster_sight_cells with no wall between.
